perf.summary: Replace O(n^2) insertion sort with O(n log n) in-place heapsort for the in-place discretization sort.
perf.currentCost: Lines 13-23 are an in-place insertion sort with worst/average O(n^2) moves; this is the entire cost of the function aside from the O(n) dedup pass.
perf.proposedChange: Sort src[0..len) in place with heapsort (no scratch buffer needed, matching this function's in-place contract), falling back to insertion sort only for tiny subarrays as an introsort base case.
perf.rationale: Drops the function from O(n^2) to O(n log n) while staying fully in-place, preserving its zero-extra-memory design. Same sorted-unique output.
perf.risk: Stability not required (output is sorted unique ints). The function's distinguishing feature vs CoordinateCompress is in-place operation, which heapsort preserves (no extra buffer). Insertion sort base case keeps small-n cache behavior.
